propositions: Compaction was removed from the close path to fix a 13m53s lock hold (P0), but left the store with no automatic compaction trigger; event logs grow until manually triggered.

A two-arm selection (backfill new tickets without snapshots; recurrence for tickets over threshold) enables the same fold engine to both backfill and re-fold grown tickets, converging after each sweep.
A scheduled 6-hourly CI workflow reusing reconcile-bridge.yml's proven recipe (ephemeral runner, store mount, bot identity, signing key materialization) provides the amortized sweep where CI exists.

An operation-linked fallback on the close path (after lock release and push) spawns a detached worker via two O(1) checks: ticket selection or stale-sweep-stamp, using the same v2 stamped advisory lock discipline as the drain, so one compactor runs at a time without reintroducing the P0.
